```{=html}
<script>
// ---- reveal on scroll (reuses your index logic style) ----
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('reveal')}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.project').forEach(n=>io.observe(n));

// ---- simple client-side filter ----
const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.filters .btn')];
const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.project')];

function applyFilter(tag){
  cards.forEach(c=>{
    const tags=(c.dataset.tags||'').split(' ');
    const show=(tag==='all') || tags.includes(tag);
    c.style.display= show ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

buttons.forEach(b=>{
  b.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    buttons.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
    b.classList.add('active');
    applyFilter(b.dataset.filter);
  });
});

applyFilter('all');
</script>
